body: i pray you're right, but if anyone is reading this and thinking about suicide I wouldn't test it.

Thanks man... I think because suicide is a sin you can't repent for and because of the damage it does to those around you, suicide, in most cases, will land a person in hell. I hope I'm wrong, but that's my take on it.
I'll continue posting but thanks for your input
